services.title: Services
services.lead: Three things I get hired for. Each one is backed by a system on this site that is running in production right now.
services.engagementBody: Fixed-scope projects for a defined build, or a monthly retainer when the system needs someone who keeps it running. Either way you deal with the person writing the code — there is no account manager in between, and no handover to a team you have not met.
services.pricing: No price list. A number without a scope is either an underquote I regret or an overquote that loses the conversation. Tell me the problem and what it currently costs you, and you get a real figure within two working days.
services.ctaTitle: Describe the problem, not the solution
services.ctaBody: The most useful first message is what is going wrong and what it costs you. I will tell you honestly whether I am the right person for it.
